scope: Separate read-only native app; no automatic computation or historical run creation

signing.team_evidence: Host-access security find-identity: one valid Apple Development identity; public certificate subject OU=ZCQ435U8JP. Restricted identity listing returned zero, not an account-absence proof.
signing.runtime_admission: Valid Apple-anchored self signature, exact configured nonempty Team ID, exact bundle ID, Hardened Runtime flag and minimal effective entitlement allowlist

historical_receipts.selection: Explicit user-selected directory grant; read-only held-descriptor snapshot; no hardcoded path fallback
historical_receipts.originals: Untouched; no move, copy, chmod, repair, resign or identity relabeling
historical_receipts.validation: Pinned terminal bytes, exact 12-leaf inventory, every size/hash, retained graph byte equality, historical identity and rational clock joins
historical_receipts.meaning: Historical receipt integrity, not new projector execution or a live source admission

apple_vm.direction: User-selected Hypervisor.framework first; separate from Virtualization.framework and Private Cloud Compute services
apple_vm.query_predicate: Self Apple signature, actual expected Team, Hardened Runtime and exact entitlement set admitted; hv outputs are observed only on HV_SUCCESS
apple_vm.future_policy: Disjoint retained guest storage; no guest networking, host writable directory sharing, clipboard or socket control channel by default; separately verify guest configuration and limits before launch

local_repository.integration_in_this_slice: Plan only; no Git process, remote fetch, package resolution or guest mount
local_repository.future_policy: Explicit read-only snapshot with commit/tree/content joins; name/path alone is not admission

writes: Build products only during verification. App has no evidence writer; macOS may create its sandbox container and ordinary framework metadata.
